title: Living-Area Part of the Appraisal Order Complexity Add-On
content:
**Living-area part — Appraisal Order complexity add-on.**

The living-area part of the complexity add-on follows how far the gross living area per dwelling unit exceeds the threshold: an overage of 1500 square feet or more is 1.8 times the report type's gross-living-area surcharge, an overage of at least 500 but under 1500 square feet is 1.4 times that surcharge, and an overage under 500 square feet is the surcharge itself. The living-area part is one of the amounts added together into the add-on subtotal of the complexity add-on, and it stands there in place of the report type's gross-living-area surcharge alone.

**Terms.**
- *Gross living area per dwelling unit* — the gross living area the Appraisal Order report states, divided by the number of units on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports.
- *Overage* — that per-unit area less the report type's gross-living-area surcharge threshold, in square feet.

| Overage per dwelling unit | Living-area part |
|---|---|
| 1500 square feet or more | 1.8 times the report type's gross-living-area surcharge |
| At least 500 but under 1500 square feet | 1.4 times the report type's gross-living-area surcharge |
| Above zero and under 500 square feet | The report type's gross-living-area surcharge |

**By report type (US dollars).**

| Report type | Threshold (sq ft) | Surcharge | 1.4 times | 1.8 times |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 4000 | 100.00 | 140.00 | 180.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 4000 | 100.00 | 140.00 | 180.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 4000 | 150.00 | 210.00 | 270.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 4000 | 150.00 | 210.00 | 270.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 4000 | 150.00 | 210.00 | 270.00 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 4000 | 200.00 | 280.00 | 360.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 4000 | 250.00 | 350.00 | 450.00 |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, threshold 4000 square feet, surcharge 150.00)
- 4499 square feet on a one-unit file: overage 499, living-area part 150.00.
- 4500 square feet on a one-unit file: overage 500, living-area part 210.00.
- 5499 square feet on a one-unit file: overage 1499, living-area part 210.00.
- 5500 square feet on a one-unit file: overage 1500, living-area part 270.00.
- 11000 square feet on a two-unit file: 5500 per unit, overage 1500, living-area part 270.00.
